hypothesis: At least one of three previously unresearched factor gates—short-term funding-spread compression, copper/gold relative strength, or Cboe SKEW decline—can improve frozen V11 CAGR while timing risk-budget deployment better than the ungated ALWAYS-FILL control, without exceeding 12% MDD or violating portfolio constraints.
allowed_changes: F-FUNDING exact DCPF3M minus DFF 20-common-observation compression gate from the frozen design
F-COPGOLD exact HG=F divided by GC=F 20-common-observation relative-strength gate from the frozen design
F-SKEW exact ^SKEW 20-observation decline gate from the frozen design
forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 parameter or target-path rule change
any factor threshold, lookback, percentile, z-score, moving-average, persistence, stale-tolerance or sign-rule search
any rebalance-band search or overlay-semantic change
combining F-FUNDING, F-COPGOLD and F-SKEW inside this trial
replacing a failed candidate after results are viewed
adding a fourth factor inside this trial
leverage, financing, shorting or negative cash
using T+0 or future factor observations
using realized candidate metrics to modify another candidate
selection_metric: No winner optimization. Compare all three factor candidates against V11-CONTROL and the non-candidate ALWAYS-FILL control, then mechanically report ADMIT_FOR_ROBUSTNESS and STRONG_INCREMENTAL flags.
pass_fail_gates: at least 4/7 fixed folds have candidate Sharpe >= ALWAYS-FILL Sharpe in the same fold
max gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or negative cash
STRONG_INCREMENTAL only if admitted plus CAGR >= V11 CAGR +1.0 percentage point and Sharpe >= V11 Sharpe
follow_up_policy: No rescue grid, threshold search, horizon change, stale-rule change, factor transformation, band change or factor combination is allowed after results. Any new transform, combination or different factor is a separately preregistered family, and all F-FUNDING/F-COPGOLD/F-SKEW results remain in G3 trial accounting.
expected_outputs: all seven fixed fold metrics for both controls and every factor candidate
trade count and average cash ratio
target fingerprint, max gross and min target weight
mechanical ADMIT_FOR_ROBUSTNESS and STRONG_INCREMENTAL flags for every factor candidate
run authorization receipt, exact execution Git commit and SHA-256 evidence manifests

F-FUNDING.derived_series: DCPF3M - DFF on common observation dates
F-FUNDING.risk_on_rule: latest usable spread <= spread 20 common observations earlier

F-COPGOLD.derived_series: HG close / GC close on common observation dates
F-COPGOLD.risk_on_rule: latest usable ratio >= ratio 20 common observations earlier

F-SKEW.risk_on_rule: latest usable close <= close 20 source observations earlier

shared_factor_rules.overlay: if risk-on, proportionally scale only already-positive frozen V11 holdings to gross 1.0; otherwise preserve V11 target
